audit.why: Favoured lane on paper (4/10) though WR is 49.91% over 4590 games: Hwei is dashless with slow, telegraphed casts; Sylas wins every stage per packet and both layers agree (Sylas x7). No chart edits needed.
Spikes are sound: E-Q gap-close at 3 that Hwei answers only with Flash, level 6 all-in on a dashless frame, first item plus Kingslayer healing winning extended trades.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names a fabricated ability, 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)', in 11 fields — Hwei's real E is Subject: Torment. breakdown.cooldowns had no digits and two bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad pastes.
audit.why: Riot's kit: E is Subject: Torment (12/11.5/11/10.5/10) carrying his CC subspells; W Subject: Serenity 18s (shield palette); Q Subject: Disaster 10s; R Spiraling Despair 120/100/80 at 1300 range — a premium steal against Hijack's 80s.
audit.corrected: Every 'Subject: Fear' occurrence replaced with Subject: Torment; cooldowns written in; bleed bullets replaced with steal-economics facts.

notes: Fabricated ability name killed: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' appeared in 11 full-layer fields; Hwei's real E is Subject: Torment (Riot kit) — every occurrence replaced, including the four report[] entries that carry it (report rewrites beyond the two-entry cap are allowed for fabricated names). Packet defect 'never names any of Hwei's abilities' refers to the content layer, which uses QE/QQ shorthand; renaming those within the ±10% band without changing meaning was not cleanly possible, so left and recorded here. focus.text edit (30 to 28 chars) stays within the band in case that field is treated as prose.
